top_themes.label: Trading & orders
top_themes.summary: Users are frustrated with frequent glitches that disrupt order execution and chart loading, leading to a low average rating. The issue is becoming more common.

top_themes.label: Onboarding & demat
top_themes.summary: New users find the login and SIP creation process quick and easy, but some face login issues after updates, indicating mixed experiences.

top_themes.label: Withdrawals & payouts
top_themes.summary: Users praise the speed of withdrawals, especially for F&O, but a few report delays in redemption payments, suggesting room for process improvement.

actions.title: Improve Order Execution Reliability
actions.detail: Implement real‑time monitoring and automated retry logic for order placement to reduce glitches and ensure orders execute promptly, especially during high‑volume periods.

actions.title: Streamline Login Post‑Update
actions.detail: Add a quick connectivity check and fallback login flow to prevent login failures after app updates, ensuring users can access the app without interruption.

actions.title: Accelerate Redemption Processing
actions.detail: Shorten the redemption approval cycle by automating status updates and notifying users instantly when funds are ready for withdrawal.
